Four Renoir Paintings Stolen in French Riviera Museum Heist

Thieves stole four paintings by Pierre-Auguste Renoir from a museum on the French Riviera. During their escape, the thieves dropped two of the stolen artworks. The value of the stolen paintings is estimated to be millions of euros. Police are investigating the incident and searching for the thieves and the two remaining missing artworks. The heist occurs amidst a reported increase in high-profile art thefts across Europe.
